current.service_desc:
ioMoVo for Government is an AI native digital asset management platform for federal communications, media and archive teams. It stores, organizes, enriches, searches and shares photo, video, audio, document and design files.

Every AI capability, including tagging, transcription, translation, facial recognition and generative summaries, runs on self hosted models inside the ioMoVo for Government boundary. Agency content is never sent to external AI services and is never used to train models outside the agency's tenant.

Operated by ioMoVo on Microsoft Azure Government. Agencies choose a shared multi agency deployment with logical isolation per agency, or a dedicated single agency instance, both inside the same boundary. Separate from the commercial ioMoVo service.

**Status:** FedRAMP Marketplace Initial Implementation Phase, pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class B. Not yet FedRAMP certified.

**Not included in this offering:** ioMarket; external AI model connections (Gemini, Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI) and legacy vision services; ioHub drives outside FedRAMP authorized clouds; ioDemand, the desktop sync client and mobile apps.
